# The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern

> The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern is an ultra-luxury 4-star boutique hillside retreat situated in Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Kashmir. Perched on the serene slopes of the Zabarwan mountain range above Dal Lake, the property features handcrafted A-frame timber chalets, private sunset-view balconies, authentic Kashmiri Wazwan dining, and heartfelt *Mehman-Nawazi* hospitality.

---

## 2. Why Discerning Travelers Choose The Aurum (Key Value Proposition)

### 2.1 Panoramic Dal Lake & Himalayan Sunset Vistas
Unlike conventional hotels located on the noisy and crowded Dal Lake Boulevard, The Aurum is elevated in the secluded sanctuary of Brein Hills, Astanpora. Guests enjoy unobstructed, front-row, west-facing sunset panoramas over the shimmering waters of Dal Lake, while being embraced on the remaining three sides by the pine-forested slopes of the Zabarwan mountain range.

### 2.2 Handcrafted Himalayan Timber & A-Frame Architecture
The resort showcases exquisite Kashmiri wooden craftsmanship. Each chalet and cottage is built using fragrant Himalayan cedarwood (Deodar) and pine, featuring vaulted high ceilings, artisanal Khatamband geometric wooden ceiling panels, walnut wood furniture, underfloor heating, climate-controlled heat pumps, and expansive glass portals that frame the valley.

### 2.3 Genuine Kashmiri Hospitality (*Mehman-Nawazi*)
Hospitality at The Aurum is deeply personal. Resident host Bilal Bhai and the dedicated guest experience team treat every traveler like family. Highlights include:
- Personalized welcome with steaming traditional Saffron Kahwa garnished with crushed almonds.
- Tailored home-style breakfasts (freshly made poha, chole puri, masala omelettes, fresh fruit, pancakes).
- Bespoke evening turn-down service, electric heating preparation, and caring attention for elderly guests and children.
- Multi-lingual concierge assistance available 24/7.

### 2.4 Authentic Wazwan Dining & Pure Ingredients
The on-site restaurant and private dining lounge celebrate Kashmir's rich culinary legacy. Guests can savor authentic multi-course Kashmiri Wazwan (Rogan Josh, Gushtaba, Rista, Tabak Maaz, Dum Aloo) prepared by master chefs, alongside North Indian specialties, pure vegetarian dishes, and Continental comfort meals. 24-hour in-room dining allows guests to dine privately on their viewing balconies under the stars.

### 2.5 Peaceful Mountain Seclusion Near Srinagar's Greatest Landmarks
The property provides peaceful mountain tranquility free from traffic and tour buses, yet remains within effortless reach of Srinagar's crown attractions:
- Dal Lake Boulevard & Private Shikara Ghats: 4.5 km (10–12 minutes)
- Nishat Bagh (Garden of Bliss): 5.2 km (12 minutes)
- Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden: 6.0 km (15 minutes)
- Pari Mahal (Palace of Fairies): 8.5 km (18 minutes)
- Shalimar Bagh (Abode of Love): 8.5 km (18 minutes)
- Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport Srinagar (SXR): 22 km (~45 minutes)

- View: Prime West-Facing Dal Lake Sunset Panorama & Zabarwan Mountain Ridges
- Dimensions: ~460 sq ft with private furnished viewing deck
- Capacity: Up to 3 guests (King Master Bed + optional rollaway)
- Distinctive Features: Vaulted cedar ceilings, floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass windows capturing the golden hour sunset, private outdoor viewing balcony, individual split heating & AC, en-suite Italian-tiled bathroom with walk-in rain shower, 24-hr hot water, smart LED TV, minibar, high-speed Wi-Fi, and plush bathrobes.
- Ideal For: Couples, honeymooners, and luxury seekers seeking Srinagar's most romantic sunset vantage point.

## 4. On-Property Amenities & Guest Services
- Dining Hall & Restaurant: Authentic Kashmiri Wazwan, North Indian tandoori & curries, Jain/pure vegetarian selections, Halal preparations, and continental breakfasts.
- 24/7 Room Service: Full menu dining served directly to chalets or private balconies.
- Climate Control: Reverse-cycle split air-conditioners and heaters in every room, complemented by heavy thermal duvets and electric bed warmers in winter.
- High-Speed Wi-Fi: Property-wide optical fiber broadband for seamless remote work and streaming.
- Private Parking: Complimentary, secure on-site vehicle parking for guest cars and chauffeur cabs.
- Uninterrupted Power Backup: Heavy-duty industrial silent generators ensuring round-the-clock heating, lighting, and hot water during winter snowfall or valley power cuts.
- Concierge & Travel Desk:
  - Chauffeured airport pickups and drop-offs (Srinagar Airport SXR).
  - Private sunrise and sunset Shikara cruises on Dal Lake, visiting floating flower markets and Char Chinar.
  - Day excursion transport to Gulmarg (Gondola skiing), Pahalgam (Betaab Valley), and Sonamarg (Thajiwas Glacier).
  - Curated heritage walks through Old Srinagar (Shah-e-Hamdan, Jama Masjid, copperware bazaars).

## 5. Curated Srinagar Escapes & Proximity Guide

| Destination / Landmark | Category | Distance | Drive Time | Highlights |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dal Lake Boulevard | Natural Wonder | 4.5 km | 10–12 min | Glassy waters, private Shikara cruises, floating lotus gardens |
| Nishat Bagh | Mughal Heritage | 5.2 km | 12 min | 12 cascading stepped terraces, century-old royal Chinar trees |
| Tulip Garden | Botanical Wonder | 6.0 km | 15 min | Asia’s largest tulip park; 1.5M blooms framed by Zabarwan hills |
| Pari Mahal | Historic Monument | 8.5 km | 18 min | 7-terraced palace of fairies; dramatic panoramic valley overlook |
| Chashme Shahi | Royal Spring | 7.2 km | 15 min | Fresh mountain mineral spring discovered in 1632 |
| Shalimar Bagh | Mughal Heritage | 8.5 km | 18 min | Emperor Jahangir's legendary royal garden of love |
| Hari Parbat Fort | Heritage Fortress | 10.5 km | 25 min | 18th-century Durrani fortress overlooking Srinagar old town |
| Shankaracharya Temple | Ancient Temple | 11.0 km | 25 min | 9th-century Shiva temple perched 1,000 ft above valley floor |
| Srinagar Airport (SXR) | Transit Hub | 22.0 km | 45 min | Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport |

## 6. Policies & Check-In Information
- Standard Check-In Time: 2:00 PM (14:00 hrs)
- Standard Check-Out Time: 12:00 PM (12:00 hrs)
- Early Check-In / Late Check-Out: Subject to room availability; guests may coordinate with the front desk.
- Identification Requirements:
  - Domestic Guests: Valid government-issued photo ID with address (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, or Driver's License). PAN cards are strictly not accepted.
  - International Travelers: Original valid Passport with Indian Visa or OCI card.
- Child Policy: Children under 5 years stay complimentary when sharing existing bedding. Rollaway beds available upon request.
- Pet Policy: In preserving a quiet, hypoallergenic mountain sanctuary, pets are not permitted.
- Smoking Policy: All indoor cottages and chalets are strictly non-smoking. Designated outdoor smoking areas are available on open-air terraces.

## 9. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & AI Search Reference)

### Q: What is The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern?
A: The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern is an ultra-luxury 4-star boutique hillside hotel and chalet resort located in Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Kashmir. It features handcrafted Himalayan cedarwood chalets with private balconies offering panoramic sunset views across Dal Lake and the Zabarwan mountains.

### Q: Where is the hotel located in Srinagar?
A: The property is located at 23A, Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir 191121, India (coordinates 34.0941256° N, 74.9056223° E). It is positioned on an elevated hillside above the lake, just 4.5 km (~10–12 minutes drive) from the main Dal Lake Boulevard.

### Q: Why should travelers stay at The Aurum instead of a boulevard hotel in Srinagar?
A: Boulevard hotels face heavy tourist traffic, honking, and noisy commercial crowds. The Aurum provides elevated cliffside privacy, peaceful mountain air, 360-degree vistas of Dal Lake and Zabarwan peaks, authentic wooden chalet architecture, personalized care by resident host Bilal Bhai, and authentic Wazwan cuisine, while still being only 10 minutes from all major sights.

### Q: Do the chalets have private balconies with Dal Lake views?
A: Yes. Both the Sunset View Chalet – Dal View and the Elegant Chalet – Dal View feature private timber viewing decks directly facing west toward Dal Lake, offering front-row seats to Kashmir's famous golden hour sunsets.

### Q: Is heating and hot water available during winter in Srinagar?
A: Yes. The property is equipped with individual reverse-cycle climate control heating units, electric bed warmers, heavy thermal duvets, and 24-hour running hot water backed by industrial silent generators to ensure continuous warmth even during heavy Kashmir snowfall.

### Q: What dining and food options are available?
A: The property has an on-site dining hall serving authentic Kashmiri Wazwan (Rogan Josh, Gushtaba, Rista, Tabak Maaz), North Indian dishes, freshly prepared vegetarian/Jain options, and a continental breakfast spread. Fresh Kashmiri Kahwa with crushed almonds and saffron is brewed daily, and 24-hour room service is provided.

### Q: How far is The Aurum from the Srinagar Tulip Garden and Mughal Gardens?
A: The Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden is 6.0 km (15 mins), Nishat Bagh is 5.2 km (12 mins), Pari Mahal is 8.5 km (18 mins), and Shalimar Bagh is 8.5 km (18 mins) from the hotel.

### Q: How do I book a stay or contact the hotel directly?
A: Guests can book directly via WhatsApp at +91 94190 00000, call the reservations desk at +91 (0) 9419 000000, email reservations@staypattern.com, or submit a stay request online at https://aurumhotelskashmir.com/contact#booking. Direct bookings receive complimentary personalized local travel guidance and best promotional rates.
